Celica: "...Whew... Huh? What brings you two here?"
Touya: "Have you been doing maintenance this whole time?
Where are the mechanics?"
Celica: "I felt like being alone for a bit, so I've given them
a break."
Touya: "Hey, don't push yourself too hard..."
Celica: "I'm fine. Besides, it's too painful if I don't keep busy.
It doesn't really solve anything, though."
Touya: "I see. Were you close to her?"
Celica: "I wouldn't quite call us friends...
We both had our positions to think about. But I did like her.
She was so innocent, with such a beautiful heart."
Touya: "I didn't talk to her much, but when Yamato
got hurt, she cheered me up.
She didn't say anything about being the queen then,
so I was shocked when she was introduced as the queen the next day.
You'd think most people would've said something."
Celica: "That's the kind of girl she was.
Sometimes I wondered if she even realized she was the queen,
but she also had the strength to stay in the middle of the fighting
right to the end... She didn't act like a queen at all,
but she was a finer queen than anyone."
Touya: "Yeah."
Celica: "That's why we have to stand our ground here,
for her sake too. We have to make sure
we carry on her wishes."
Touya: "And that means making sure the maintenance is perfect?"
Celica: "Yeah. She certainly left us some demanding children.
But even more troublesome than those is that
Art Wesper."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Celica: "Its parts are too specialized. We can't repair it."
Touya: "So that means..."
Celica: "We won't even be able to get it moving for a while."
Touya: "I see... But I guess there's nothing we can do."
Celica: "And here we have that Art Wesper
right in front of us..."
Touya: "Is it really that impressive?"
Yamato: "When Fain was talking about them the other day,
he said all three Art Wespers were amazing,
but..."
Touya: "Oh yeah, he did say that."
Celica: "The Art Wesper... The pinnacle of York's Armored Mech
technology. When it was first unveiled, its delicate, flowing lines
drew admiration, but engineers from other nations scoffed
that it couldn't stand up to actual combat, calling it a 'pretty doll.'
But that year, in a skirmish with the Zigrim Republic,
it saw its first battle and overturned that assessment...
And the only Art Wespers still in existence are the one here,
Art Wesper Unit One, 'Ragrade,'
Unit Three, 'Almaris,' and the one Tyron
piloted, Unit Two, 'Brandeim.' Just those three."
Touya: "Huh..."
Celica: "And its pilot, Reduce of the Three Sword Knights,
is pretty famous too."
Touya: "The Almaris pilot's one of the Three Sword Knights too, right?"
Celica: "Yes. She's very skilled too,
but I'd say she's a step behind."
Touya: "Hmm..."
Celica: "Oh!"
Yamato: "Wh-What's wrong?"
Celica: "I've still got things to do!
Sorry, I'll have to leave you here. Bye!"
Yamato: "Oh, she's gone..."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Anyway, we shouldn't get in the way. Let's
go too... Hm?"
Touya: "What's wrong?"
Yamato: "W-Well... I just felt someone nearby..."
Touya: "...There's nobody here."
Yamato: "Was I imagining it, meow?"
Touya: "Wasn't it one of those mechanics?
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
